summary: HDFC Bank Limited furnished a Form 6-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing only a routine board meeting scheduled for October 17, 2026 to consider and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ending September 30, 2026, the US-equivalent quarterly earnings notice. It also announced a trading window closure for designated employees and immediate relatives from September 24 to October 19, 2026 under the bank's share dealing code. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is referenced; the filing is an ordinary earnings-calendar disclosure with no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
